producer_report.summary: Athena now formats the producer's work tree itself. After each producer pass, before the change list is taken, it runs `cargo fmt --all` and then `cargo fmt --all --check` on the tree. So a job whose only defect is rustfmt layout reaches the checks and the verifier formatted. The root cause was that the producer may run `cargo fmt`, but only prose asked it to, and nothing made the tree formatted before the gate. The step is new file run/format.rs, called from `producer_loop` through a small method in producer.rs. It is Athena code, not an agent command, so policy.rs is unchanged. It runs only when the tree has a Cargo.toml and a non-deleted .rs file is in the change list; pinned studies are skipped. A parse error stays in the tree and the normal fmt check fails on it with rustfmt's text. The kill switch or a deadline during the step ends the job as failed with "the format step stopped: …", and no check or verifier runs. Five unit tests and two end-to-end tests through `Athena::go` cover this. I disabled the call once to confirm both end-to-end tests fail without it; I did not do that for the unit tests, since they call the step directly. The CHANGELOG has an Unreleased entry. The dropped skill work (diagnose-failure.md, introspect.rs, introspection.rs) is absent.

criteria_check.evidence: producer.rs calls `self.format_stage(...)` inside each producer_loop pass, right after the producer report is parsed and before `snapshot.change_list()`, `loop_replay` and the loop exit. The module docs of format.rs and the producer_loop doc comment say it is the last producer-stage act of every pass, with the candidate, checks and verifier after it. This is the placement the reading's assumption names (end of producer_loop, before the change list is taken), not after the loop. open_issues: Open question from the plan, left to a separate request: an error the formatter cannot fix does not send the producer back; the fmt check reports it at verification, as the reading says.
The new tests run real `cargo fmt` under the pinned toolchain from rust-toolchain.toml, so a host without that toolchain fails them rather than skipping.
learnings: `crate::checks::run_check` clears the environment, so tests that run real cargo fmt must pass PATH, HOME and the rustup variables themselves. A rust-toolchain.toml next to the temp crate pins the rustfmt version.
A Cargo.toml tree with no `.rs` change never reaches the step: format_stage returns early without computing git trees, so fake-job tests without a Cargo.toml pay nothing.

The fake agent driver checks the kill switch only before the script runs, so a script that writes the STOP file during the producer turn is first seen by the format step. In that test, closing the job as Failed works with the switch still set.
run/mod.rs already has a private `mod checks;`, so format.rs must use `crate::checks::…` explicitly.
